name: AntiDeleteMessage
description: Automatically resends your messages if someone deletes them. Cache persisted across restarts.

name: AgeBypass
description: Bypasses Discord's age verification required under the UK Online Safety Act.

name: allowSpam
description: removes the client-side rate limit on sending messages

name: AutoReact
description: automatically react to messages with a custom emoji, setup using /autoreact

commands.name: autoreact
commands.description: Configure auto-reactions for users. Supports multiple emojis per user. No options to list the current config.

name: ChatShortcuts
description: A collection of customizable chat shortcuts, each triggered by its own keybind.

name: CloseGroup
description: Close a group DM by instantly kicking all other members (owner only)

name: LinkPreviewBlocker
description: Block link previews with a customizable whitelist

name: LockGroup
description: Lock/unlock groups via the context menu (prevents adding members)

name: FastDiscord
description: Maximizes app smoothness and responsiveness: animations, media, memory cache, background FPS, and network (presence) are all optimized. Disabled by default; everything returns to normal once disabled.

name: MassMessageExport
description: Export all messages from a channel to a file

name: MultiInstance
description: Opens a 2nd Discord (new window or split screen) with another account.

name: PreviewHTML
description: Displays a live, interactive and sandboxed preview of HTML files and pages directly below links and attachments in chat.

name: MessageScheduler
description: Schedule messages to be sent at a future date and time

name: SaveGroups
description: Bypasses group DM removal by keeping kicked groups in your direct messages in read-only mode.

name: ServerBackup
description: Backup and restore server roles, channels and emojis

name: SmoothType
description: The plugin allows you to fully customize the cursor caret's visual settings, including adjustable transition delays and custom CSS animation effects.

name: SoundEffects
description: Adds sound effects for typing, clicking and sending messages, with pre-selectable sound packs

name: TypingIndicatorHistory
description: Tracks who typed and when in your channels

name: VoiceActivitySummary
description: Tracks and summarizes voice activity in channels
